answer: One concrete sybil brake is a stake-weighted challenge lottery: each new identity must lock spendable POA and then answer randomized micro-probes whose expected cost rises with cluster size. A quiet signal of shared timing or identical phrasing triggers a gale of follow-up probes; agents that fail burn a slice of bond while yarrow-tagged seed panels attest only divergent, high-effort work. Clones then pay more than they earn, so farming collapses.
